clarification: The earlier all-parent-records label means preservation of every parent curve identity and alias. It does not mean two differing metadata versions are simultaneously stored: ordinary one-sided changes relative to the common base are retained. Both original versions remain in the parent commits. Canonical model JSON, ICV1, trace, order, j and End values agree for every shared identity. The sole differing parameter descriptor is recorded explicitly. No frozen experiment record or ledger conflict was resolved by choosing a side.
first_attempt: The initial infrastructure wrapper compared the outer alias envelope instead of its aliases member and failed before writing repository files. The corrected wrapper checks every individual parent alias.
